question: As per the 2023 statistic, which of the following neighbouring countries of India had the lowest infant mortality rate?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sri Lanka** has consistently been one of the best-performing countries in the South Asia region in terms of **infant mortality rate**.
 
• As per the **2023 statistics**, Sri Lanka recorded the lowest infant mortality rate among India’s neighboring countries, owing to its **well-developed healthcare system**.
 
• The country has a strong focus on **maternal and infant health**, ensuring better outcomes through **universal health coverage** and accessible healthcare facilities.
